scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tools && for d in plugins/*/; do tsc -p "$d" || exit 1; done
scripts.validate: claude plugin validate . && for d in plugins/*/; do claude plugin validate "$d" || exit 1; done
scripts.test: bun test tools && for d in plugins/*/; do claude plugin test "$d" || exit 1; done
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun run validate && bun run test
